main_text.p: secula evenient, veluti ex ma-gno loci intervallo, ab eo solo praevidentur, cujus pupuli inconniventes non solum longe diffita circumquaque con-spiciunt, verùm etiam maximè occulta cordis cogitata intuentur. Ea tamen est mortalium curiositas, utavidè & anxiè in illa inquirant, quorum contemplationem sibi reservatam voluit, providentiæ Parens. Et quia ea scrutari hominibus est denegatum, ideo per obli-quum id quaerunt, quod rectâ viâ non valent assequi. Unde soliti in multis casibus, ad casualia & fortuita recurrere, ex iisque de futuris contingenti-bus facere indicium ac judi-cium. Vel avium commissiones in bonam aut malam partem trahentur, modo singulis partes sint assignatæ. Alii tauros adversus leones incitabunt ut de futuri belli eventu, certi quid

page.notes: The first word is printed with a long s ("secula"), read as "secula". Words in the text are copied as printed, with long s normalised to s. The catchword "quid" is at the lower right. The faint text at the bottom right is a digitiser's mark and is left out.
